hero.title: Real experiences. Meaningful progress.
hero.description: Every recovery journey is different. These experiences reflect the value of understanding the person, building trust, and progressing with a clear clinical direction.

video.consentNote: Patient video shared with written ethical consent.

ethics.note: Clinical note: All shared patient feedback and video excerpts are published with explicit informed consent in compliance with medical confidentiality standards.

tarekRotatorCuff.quote: I thought surgery was inevitable. Dr. Mohamed explained the biomechanics and made me an active partner until I completely regained my arm mobility.
tarekRotatorCuff.author: Tarek M.

sarahAcl.quote: The first time a physiotherapist listened to every single habit in my day and running routine before touching my knee. Understanding was what made all the difference.
sarahAcl.author: Sarah M.

karimAcl.quote: Dr. Mohamed restored my trust in every jump and stride on the pitch through rigorous objective testing.
karimAcl.author: Karim A.

mahmoudLumbar.quote: My recovery journey from a lumbar disc issue without perpetual painkillers — how Dr. Mohamed taught me to manage my daily movement.
mahmoudLumbar.author: Mahmoud H.

nadiaClinical.quote: The serenity of the space and singular focus during sessions is rare. Dr. Mohamed practices with the highest clinical and ethical rigor.
nadiaClinical.author: Dr. Nadia F.

omarCalisthenics.quote: Overuse wrist and elbow rehabilitation — progressing from complete rest back to peak athletic output.
omarCalisthenics.author: Omar Sh.
